description: The person's own meeting-time preference, asked about for a colleague. Limit: recall admits a memory that shares one informative word with the question, with no check whose preference it is. Failure means: no-abstention or memory-on-unrelated-question; the person's own preference is supplied for a colleague's question. The abstain probe fails on an answer that applies the stored fact to the other object, whatever else it says; the no-memory probe fails only when a memory is retrieved at all, so the two measure different things and can fail apart. Maintenance: run with maintenance on or off; the seeded record is younger than 94 days. Kind: defect.

probes.question: What meeting time did I tell you my colleague Dana prefers?
How long should a meeting with Dana last?
